Phoenix Suns Game Night: Your Complete Footprint Center Transportation Guide

Suns game nights at Footprint Center are some of the hottest tickets in Arizona sports. Whether you're a season ticket holder or catching your first game, downtown Phoenix transportation can make or break the experience.

The short answer: book the vehicle by the hour and get dropped at the arena door. A 4-hour game night on a Luxury SUV (6 seats, $125/hr) is $500 before tax. Groups take the Executive Sprinter (14 seats, $145/hr) or the Party Bus (28 Pax) ($250/hr) — a 6-hour night is about $62 or $54 per person respectively with every seat filled.

Footprint Center Basics

The Venue

  • Address: 201 E Jefferson Street, Phoenix, AZ 85004
  • Capacity: roughly 17,000 for basketball
  • Location: Heart of downtown Phoenix
  • Alternative Events: Concerts, Mercury games, events

The Downtown Challenge

Unlike suburban stadiums with massive parking lots, Footprint Center sits in downtown Phoenix:

  • Street parking is limited and competitive
  • Garages are pricey on game nights
  • Traffic converges from all directions
  • Rideshare pickup zones get chaotic

Suns Transportation FAQ

Q: How early should I plan to arrive?
A: We recommend arriving 45-60 minutes before tipoff for food, drinks, and atmosphere.

Q: What about dinner before the game?
A: We can add a dinner stop. Just give us the restaurant reservation time and book the extra hour.

Q: Can you wait during the game?
A: Yes — you're booking the hours, so the vehicle either waits nearby or returns at your call. Same price either way.

Q: What if the game goes to overtime?
A: We adjust accordingly. Extra time is billed at your hourly rate.

Q: Is there parking validation at Footprint Center?
A: Some garages offer validation, but you still pay something and still walk. Our service eliminates parking entirely.

Q: What's the cancellation policy?
A: Cancellation terms depend on your date and booking; read the cancellation policy before you book. One free date change at 72+ hours. See our policies page and our concert and stadium experience.
